svg.title: Wine bottle bag plan
svg.desc: A bottle inside a straight crochet tube. The flat base of 40 stitches sits under the bottle and adds no height. The side rounds start at round 8 and rise 9 inches, 45 rounds, to just above the shoulder. The eyelet round and two rounds above it gather around the neck. A carry handle is sewn to solid rounds below the eyelets on opposite sides. A note says not to lift the bottle by the drawstring, because the cord hangs the whole weight on the chain-1 loops of one round.
svg.text: Base under, sides up, cord above the shoulder
9 in = 45 rounds to the cord point
base: flat, 40 sts, adds no height
